import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;
    static final long MOD1 = 998244353L;
    static final int T = 14;

    static long mod_pow(long b, long e, long m) {
        long r = 1;
        b %= m;
        while (e > 0) {
            if ((e & 1) == 1) r = (r * b) % m;
            b = (b * b) % m;
            e >>= 1;
        }
        return r;
    }

    static class LinearAlg {
        static List<Long> BM(List<Long> s) {
            int n = s.size();
            List<Long> cur = new ArrayList<>();
            List<Long> ls = new ArrayList<>();
            int lf = -1;
            long ld = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                long val = 0;
                for (int j = 0; j < cur.size(); ++j)
                    val = (val + s.get(i - j - 1) * cur.get(j)) % MOD;
                val = (val - s.get(i)) % MOD;
                if (val == 0) continue;
                if (cur.isEmpty()) {
                    cur = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(i + 1, 0L));
                    lf = i;
                    ld = val;
                    continue;
                }
                long k = (-val * mod_pow(ld, MOD - 2, MOD)) % MOD;
                List<Long> c = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(i - lf - 1, 0L));
                c.add(k);
                for (int j = 0; j < ls.size(); ++j)
                    c.add((-ls.get(j) * k) % MOD);
                if (c.size() < cur.size()) {
                    while (c.size() < cur.size()) c.add(0L);
                }
                for (int j = 0; j < cur.size(); ++j)
                    c.set(j, (c.get(j) + cur.get(j)) % MOD);
                if (cur.size() < i - lf + ls.size()) {
                    ls = new ArrayList<>(cur);
                    lf = i;
                    ld = val;
                }
                cur = c;
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < cur.size(); ++i) {
                long x = cur.get(i);
                cur.set(i, (x % MOD + MOD) % MOD);
            }
            return cur;
        }

        static List<Long> h;
        static List<Long> a;
        static int m;

        static void mul(List<Long> p, List<Long> q) {
            List<Long> t = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(m * 2, 0L));
            for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
                if (p.get(i) != 0) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < m; ++j) {
                        t.set(i + j, (t.get(i + j) + p.get(i) * q.get(j)) % MOD);
                    }
                }
            }
            for (int i = m * 2 - 1; i >= m; --i) {
                if (t.get(i) != 0) {
                    for (int j = m - 1; j >= 0; --j) {
                        t.set(i - j - 1, (t.get(i - j - 1) + t.get(i) * h.get(j)) % MOD);
                    }
                }
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
                p.set(i, t.get(i));
            }
        }

        static long calc(long k) {
            List<Long> s = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(m, 0L));
            List<Long> t = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(m, 0L));
            s.set(0, 1L);
            if (m != 1) {
                t.set(1, 1L);
            } else {
                t.set(0, h.get(0));
            }
            while (k > 0) {
                if ((k & 1) == 1) {
                    mul(s, t);
                }
                mul(t, t);
                k >>= 1;
            }
            long res = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
                res = (res + s.get(i) * a.get(i)) % MOD;
            }
            return (res % MOD + MOD) % MOD;
        }

        static long solve(List<Long> seq, long n) {
            if (n < seq.size()) return seq.get((int) n);
            h = BM(seq);
            m = h.size();
            if (m == 0) return 0;
            a = new ArrayList<>(h);
            for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
                a.set(i, seq.get(i));
            }
            return calc(n);
        }
    }

    static long f(long x, long up) {
        long cnt = 0;
        String s = Long.toString(x);
        int len = s.length();
        if (x > 0) cnt++;
        for (int i = 1; i < T; i++) {
            long lo = 1, hi = x;
            for (int j = 0; j + 1 < i; j++) lo *= 10;
            for (int j = len; j < i; j++) hi *= 10;
            if (i < len) {
                String pre = s.substring(0, Math.min(i, s.length()));
                hi = Long.parseLong(pre) + 1;
            }
            if (hi > up) hi = up;
            if (hi > lo) cnt += hi - lo;
        }
        return cnt;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        
        long n = Long.parseLong(br.readLine());
        n++;
        long limit = n;
        
        long adj = (n % MOD) * ((n / MOD1) + 2) % MOD;
        adj = (MOD - adj) % MOD;
        
        long res = 0;
        for (long off = -n / MOD1 - 1; off <= n / MOD1 + 1; off++) {
            long cnt = 0;
            for (int d = 0; d < T; d++) {
                long L = 0, R = 1;
                if (d >= 1) {
                    L = 1;
                    for (int k = 0; k + 1 < d; k++) L *= 10;
                    R = L * 10;
                }
                if (R > n) R = n;
                long lastR = R;
                if (L < R) {
                    L--;
                    while (R - L > 1) {
                        long mid = (L + R) >> 1;
                        if (f(mid, limit) > mid + MOD1 * off - 1) R = mid;
                        else L = mid;
                    }
                    cnt += lastR - R;
                }
            }
            res += cnt;
        }
        
        res %= MOD;
        res = ((-res - adj) % MOD * MOD1) % MOD;
        res = (res % MOD + MOD) % MOD;
        pw.println(res);
        
        pw.close();
    }
}
